Learn about the app and usage tips

• Add and edit full bean info: name, roast level, process method, origin, development time, flavor notes, roast date, and more. • Supports custom photos and backgrounds; tap remaining stock to quickly adjust it. • Auto-counts the resting countdown and remaining flavor window, with expiry reminders.

• “Brew Pour-Over” / “Brew Espresso” deduct the set amount from stock in one tap; defaults 15 g / 18 g, both customizable. • Every deduction is saved automatically; view the full log under Profile → Brew History. Clear all records in one tap, with a confirmation step.
• Multiple theme palettes: Sunset Orange, Rose Pink, Forest Green, and more. • Dark mode in three levels: Follow System, Light, Dark, with immersive UI adaptation.

• Compatible with 58 mm ESC/POS Bluetooth label printers (203 dpi, 50×50 mm labels). • Prints: bean name, roast level, process method, origin, development time, flavor notes, roast date, best-before, rest time. • Tip: pair the printer in your phone\'s system Bluetooth settings first; common PINs: 0000 / 1234.

• Rest days count from the roast date; the card shows “Resting X days”. • Flavor window = roast date + best-before days; shows “Flavor window X days” before expiry, and a red “Expired X days” highlight after.

• Tap the remaining grams on the card to open a quick-edit dialog — handy for opening a new bag or taking inventory. • “Cups left” is an estimate based on your current pour-over/espresso amounts, for reference only.

• On the add-bean page, origin and process method support multi-select with presets; press Enter to add custom entries. • The save button is light grass green; name and roast date are required before saving.

• Every “Brew Pour-Over/Espresso” is logged with time, deducted amount, and stock before/after. • Under Profile → Brew History, delete single records or clear all at once (double confirmation; deletions cannot be undone).

Welcome to this app. It is a purely local, offline tool for recording and managing coffee bean roasting info, and supports printing roast labels via Bluetooth to a standard-protocol label printer. By using this app you confirm that you have read and agree to all terms of this privacy policy; if you do not agree, please stop using the app.

This app does not collect, upload, or share any personal information. 1. No account registration or login required; no phone number, email, or ID requested. 2. The app has no network capability — it never accesses the internet, never connects to any cloud server, and never uploads data. 3. No analytics, tracking, ads, or crash-reporting third-party SDKs are integrated; nothing is ever reported externally.

All data you enter — roast records, bean info, curve parameters, label templates — is stored only in your phone\'s local storage and is accessible only to you. - Data is never synced to any network; backup and export are performed manually by you. - Uninstalling the app deletes the local database with it. Please keep your own backups of important data.

This app requests only the minimum permissions needed for its features, and no unrelated permissions. 1. Bluetooth (BLE) permission Used only to search and connect to Bluetooth label printers for printing roast labels. Device info produced during scanning/connecting is handled temporarily in local memory — never saved or uploaded. If Bluetooth is denied, printing is unavailable but all local recording features still work. 2. Local storage permission Used to save the roast record database and manually exported CSV files; the app only accesses its own files and does not read unrelated files on your phone. This app does not request camera, location, contacts, microphone, or other non-essential permissions.
This app uses no third-party services. It only performs local Bluetooth communication and reports no data.
Minors should have a guardian read and agree to this privacy policy before using the app.
This app is an offline tool; if future features change how data is handled, this policy will be updated.
This software is developed by an individual hobbyist. If you have questions, please reach out via the project\'s open-source page.

Privacy Policy
Updated: 2026-08-27 Policy version: 1
Welcome to BeanBag (CoffeeBeanTracker). We know how important your personal information is. This app is designed around one principle: your data never leaves your device.
1. What We Collect This app does not collect, upload, or share any of your personal information. No account registration is required, and no sensitive permissions (contacts, location, microphone, etc.) are requested.
2. Where Your Data Lives All your green bean and roasted bean stock and brewing records are stored only in the app\'s private local directory on this device. Uninstalling the app deletes them permanently.
3. File Access Storage is accessed only when you actively export or import backup/log files, and files are saved where you choose. Backup files are kept by you; we hold no copies.
4. Protection of Minors This app is for coffee enthusiasts and does not collect any information from children.
5. Policy Updates If future features involve any new data handling, we will update this policy and ask for your consent again via an in-app notice.
